user.title: Upstate New York residential electricity
user.description: Choose your National Grid load zone for standard residential SC-1 service with National Grid supplying electricity. Other suppliers, time-of-use, agricultural discounts, solar and account-specific credits are not included. No utility account is needed.

location.title: Select your tax jurisdictions
location.description: Select your legal city/village or listed undergrounding area, then your residential energy sales-tax jurisdiction from NY Publication 718-R Part 1. School-district boundaries can differ from city and ZIP boundaries. Choose the no-listed-tax option only if no listed county, city or school district applies. Rates update automatically. For Syracuse: City of Syracuse and no listed tax. This uses no address or account information.

error.cannot_connect: Could not retrieve a complete, effective rate from the official sources. Retry later; an expired exemption or changed filing may need an integration update.
error.invalid_location: Select both locations from the official lists.

abort.already_configured: This rate and tax location is already configured.
